test_pandas_dtype: test the pandas_dtype function to convert a dtype string or type to a pandas dtype object
test_is_numeric_dtype: test the is_numeric_dtype function to check if a dtype is numeric
test_is_list_like: test the is_list_like function to check if an object is list-like but not a string or dict
test_is_scalar: test the is_scalar function to check if a value is a pandas scalar
test_is_datetime64_any_dtype: test the is_datetime64_any_dtype function to check if a dtype is datetime64
